summary: Shows running all sanity tests for a collection in the default Docker container.
questions: How do I run the sanity tests on my collection?
What command runs ansible-test sanity in Docker?

answer_card.title: Run collection sanity tests
answer_card.answer_md:
```shell-session
ansible-test sanity --docker default -v
```
See the sanity tests list for what each test checks and how to fix failures.
